## What

A first written contract for `{{COMPONENT_NAME}}`, drafted from its types, docs examples and tests, in the form `CLAUDE.md` § Component contract defines. Its Status line reads `Draft, not reviewed`.

## Why

A component with no written contract can't be checked against one. This draft gives the reviewer something to correct instead of a blank page.

## If we don't do it

`{{COMPONENT_NAME}}` stays outside the contract check and the second-opinion review, and the next change to it is reviewed from memory.
